data.title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
data.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform.

Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries.

data.title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Architektur, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer AWS-Umgebungen und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen, die echten Business Impact erzeugen.

Was du bei uns machst
  • Du entwirfst und implementierst skalierbare, sichere und hochverfügbare Plattformarchitekturen auf AWS und anderen Cloud Providern.
  • Du treibst Automatisierung konsequent voran (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).

data.title: Core Developer - Platform
data.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain - the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary.

Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Software Engineer

We are a product company building software for industrial customers. You will design, build and run backend services in Python and TypeScript, work closely with product and design, review code, improve our CI/CD pipelines and help the team ship small changes to production every day.

  • Several years of professional software development
  • Experience with SQL databases, Docker and a public cloud
  • Good English; German is a plus
